links.name: Lu4
Iron Punch Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 34 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Focused Force Lv. 1 Channels force energy when using a hand-to-hand and blunt weapon. Can be charged up to Level 1.
Force Blaster Lv. 1 Discharges a powerful energy beam at an enemy with 143 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Hurricane Assault Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 501 Power to strike the target with rapid consecutive strikes. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. Ignores Shield Defence.
Bear Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: P. Atk. +20% P. Crit. Damage +20%. Speed -30%.
Wolf Spirit Totem Lv. 1 Speed +20% With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Accuracy +3.
Cripple Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%.
Stunning Fist Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 45 Power added to P. Atk. and stuns them. Over-hit is possible.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Asceticism Lv. 1 While this skill is active, Vampiric-type effects do not restore your health.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Fist Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using a hand-to-hand weapon.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +1 Evasion +4 Received P. Crit. Rate -15%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Sword/Blunt Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using one-handed/two-handed Sword or one-handed/two-handed/dual Blunt weapon.
Two-handed Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 and Accuracy by 3 when using a two-handed sword or a two-handed blunt weapon.
Agile Movement Lv. 1 Accuracy +2 and Speed by 5 when equipped with light armor.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Toughness Lv. 1 Resistance to Sleep/Hold/Poison +20%.
Boost Attack Speed Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. +5%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Iron Body Lv. 1 Environment-related damage is decreased by 40%.

Force Mastery Lv. 1 Absorbs the target's energy. Energy can be absorbed with a 15% chance for regular physical attacks and 30% during a critical attack. Applies when a hand-to-hand combat weapon is equipped. Up to 1 stage of energy can be absorbed.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
